open_points.subject: MCP operation `get_repair_view` continuation behavior
open_points.text: "with a continuation token that also carries the implementation set of its first page; passed back, it pages only the NodeExecutions below that position for that set"
open_points.question: What exact validation and refusal behavior applies when a continuation token is well-formed but carries an implementation set that differs from the slot’s current set (for example after new implementations are added), or when caller-supplied page size changes across pages?
options: Treat token’s embedded implementation set as authoritative snapshot and ignore current set changes
Refuse when embedded set differs from recomputed current set
Allow page-size changes; token controls only position+set
Require same page size as first page
open_points.default_guess: Treat the token as an immutable snapshot (position+implementation set), allow page-size change, and page strictly within that snapshot; refuse only malformed or mismatched-slot tokens.

open_points.subject: `functions.read_slot` verdict grouping order details
open_points.text: "its implementations in store order each with its verdicts grouped by corpus digest — groups in the store order of their first verdict"
open_points.question: Within each corpus-digest group, what is the order of verdict entries, and can there be more than one verdict per (implementation, corpus_digest)?
options: Exactly one verdict per (implementation, corpus_digest), so intra-group order is vacuous
Allow multiple; order by store order
open_points.default_guess: Assume at most one verdict per (implementation, corpus_digest); return single entry per group.

open_points.subject: `store.read_records` identity-read failure reporting determinism
open_points.text: "`unknown_reference` for the whole call when any named identity does not exist; nothing is returned."
open_points.question: If multiple named identities are missing in one call, which missing identity is named in the reason text (if any), and in what deterministic order are existence checks performed?
options: Check in caller-given identity order; first missing is named
Check in sorted order; first missing is named
Do not name a specific identity in reason
open_points.default_guess: Check in caller-given order and report the first missing identity.
